item.title: Lilly Obesity Drug Trial and Alzheimer's Claims
item.description:
• Summary: Eli Lilly faces scrutiny over its obesity drug clinical trial data and marketing claims for its Alzheimer's treatment. The Pharmalot report questions the robustness of the obesity trial's endpoints and highlights concerns about the evidence supporting Lilly's Alzheimer's drug efficacy. The combination of therapeutic areas—metabolic and neurologic—has raised questions about the company's clinical development strategy and regulatory transparency.
  • MoAs: N/A (specific drug not identified in the theme summary)
  • Sources: STAT News

item.title: ATS 2026 COPD Emphysema Gene
item.description:
• Summary: At the American Thoracic Society (ATS) 2026 conference, researchers identified the PABPC4 gene as a key driver of emphysema in chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD). The finding was presented as part of a larger genetic analysis linking specific gene expression patterns to lung tissue destruction. The discovery could open new avenues for targeted therapies aimed at halting or reversing emphysema progression.
  • MoAs: N/A (gene identified; no specific drug mechanism)
  • Sources: Pharmaceutical Technology

item.title: Infex Lung Disease Candidate
item.description:
• Summary: Infex, following in the footsteps of Insmed, advanced its lung disease candidate after positive Phase 2a data. The drug is a DPP-1 inhibitor targeting neutrophil-driven inflammation in bronchiectasis.
  • MoAs: Dipeptidyl peptidase 1 (DPP-1) inhibitor
  • Sources: Fierce Biotech
